content:
I checked both Fasteners Tools INDX bags, and every other bag and box and can not find the sleeves. 

 Am assuming they are ID 2mm and OD 5mm, does anyone have a good height measurement on them so I can look for something similar?
For the 4T version, there are only (2x) Magnet 3.2 x 5 in the plastic case.
They should reorder this list such that the magnets come before the screws, That way we are not picking up those bags twice in the same step.

If you are building the 8T version, there are two bags labeled "Fasteners Tools INDX". 
The bags contain the same things, so if you are wondering why you only have two magnets or 4 collets, that's where you find the rest.

replies.content: I feel like 15% of the time spent on this is searching through bags and boxes :)
